$comment: PR-27. Everything outside the repository the method needs: GitHub secrets and variables, and the app's Vercel environment. scripts/devos/setup-check.mjs checks names only and keeps the Dev OS setup issue up to date. when: always | module:<name> | var:<NAME> | method. blocks: cycle | deploy | none.

items.title: Cursor key for the builder (one or two accounts)
steps: cursor.com → Dashboard → Integrations → API Keys → create a key named devos.
GitHub → this repository → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret `CURSOR_API_KEY`, paste the key.
Optional second account (PR-29): its key as `CURSOR_API_KEY_2`. A run then switches to it when the first reaches its usage limit.

items.title: Claude credential for the reviewer (one or two accounts)
steps: On your computer run `claude setup-token` and sign in with your Claude plan.
Add the token as the repository secret `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` (or an API key as `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`).
Optional second account (PR-29): `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN_2` (or `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_2`). A review then switches to it when the first reaches its usage limit.

items.title: OpenAI key for Codex (one or two accounts)
steps: platform.openai.com → API keys → Create new secret key, named devos.
GitHub → this repository → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret `OPENAI_API_KEY`, paste the key.
Optional second account (PR-29): its key as `OPENAI_API_KEY_2`. A run then switches to it when the first reaches its usage limit.

items.title: Gemini API key (one or two accounts)
steps: aistudio.google.com → Get API key → Create API key, named devos.
GitHub → this repository → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret `GEMINI_API_KEY`, paste the key.
Optional second account (PR-29): its key as `GEMINI_API_KEY_2`. A run then switches to it when the first reaches its usage limit.

items.title: Runner token that may change workflows (method fixes)
steps: GitHub → your avatar → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens → Fine-grained → Generate.
Repository access: only this repository. Permissions (Read and write): Contents, Pull requests, Issues, Actions, Commit statuses, **Workflows**.
Add it as the repository secret `DEVOS_PAT`. GitHub's own runner token can never push a change to `.github/workflows/`, so a method fix that touches a workflow needs this one.

items.title: Vercel deploy access
steps: vercel.com → Account Settings → Tokens → create `devos` (scope: your team).
Project → Settings → General: copy the Project ID; team Settings: copy the Team ID (`VERCEL_ORG_ID`).
GitHub → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → New repository secret, once for each: `VERCEL_TOKEN`, `VERCEL_ORG_ID`, `VERCEL_PROJECT_ID`.

items.title: Vercel protection bypass (previews and smoke tests)
steps: Vercel → project → Settings → Deployment Protection → Protection Bypass for Automation → create a secret.
Add it as the repository secret `VERCEL_AUTOMATION_BYPASS_SECRET`.

items.title: Turn on the Vercel deploy step
steps: GitHub → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → Variables → New repository variable `DEVOS_VERCEL` = `true`.

items.title: Supabase production project (deploy: backup and migrations)
steps: supabase.com → New project for production; set a strong database password and keep it (`SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD`).
Project Settings → General: copy the Reference ID (`SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF`); Account → Access Tokens: create `devos` (`SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN`).
Choose a long backup passphrase (`DEVOS_BACKUP_PASSPHRASE`): the deploy encrypts every backup with it. Keep a copy offline.
GitHub → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions: add the four as repository secrets.

items.title: Turn on the database step of the deploy
steps: GitHub → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → Variables → New repository variable `DEVOS_SUPABASE` = `true`.

items.title: Supabase values the site reads (Vercel Production)
steps: Supabase → Project Settings: copy the project URL (Data API) and the publishable key (API Keys).
Vercel → project → Settings → Environment Variables → environment **Production**: add both under the names above.

items.title: Cloudflare R2 bucket (deploy: storage preflight)
steps: Cloudflare → R2 → Create bucket (`R2_BUCKET`); its Settings → Public access: turn on the r2.dev URL or connect a custom domain (`R2_PUBLIC_BASE_URL`).

R2 → Manage API tokens → Create API token: Object Read & Write, for this bucket only. Copy the Access Key ID, the Secret Access Key and the S3 endpoint `https://<account id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com` (`R2_ENDPOINT`).
GitHub → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions: add the five as repository secrets.

items.title: Turn on the storage preflight of the deploy
steps: Repository variable `DEVOS_R2` = `true`.

items.title: R2 values the site reads (Vercel Production)
steps: Vercel → project → Settings → Environment Variables → environment **Production**: the same five names and values; mark `R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID` and `R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` Sensitive.

items.title: Firebase project (deploy: rules and seed)
steps: console.firebase.google.com → Add project, with Google Analytics off; Build → Firestore Database → Create database. Its project ID is `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID`.
Google Cloud console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts: create `devos-deploy` with the role Firebase Admin; Keys → Add key → JSON.
GitHub → Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions: add `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID`, and `FIREBASE_DEPLOY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT` = the key's whole JSON; then delete the downloaded file.

items.title: Turn on the Firestore step of the deploy
steps: Repository variable `DEVOS_FIREBASE` = `true`.

items.title: Firestore values the site reads (Vercel Production)
steps: Google Cloud console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts: create `devos-runtime` with the read-only role Cloud Datastore Viewer; Keys → Add key → JSON.

Vercel → project → Settings → Environment Variables → environment **Production**: `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID`, and `FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT` = that key's whole JSON, marked Sensitive; then delete the downloaded file.

items.title: The project's production URL
steps: Vercel → Environment Variables → Production: DEVOS_PRODUCTION_URL = https://<the production hostname> with no trailing slash.

items.title: xAI key for generated media (optional)
steps: console.x.ai → API Keys → Create: only the Image, Video and Text to speech endpoints, and the models grok-imagine-image-2.0 and grok-imagine-video-1.5-lite.
Billing: keep the invoiced billing limit at $0 and auto top-up off, so requests stop when prepaid credits run out.
Add it as the repository secret `DEVOS_MEDIA_XAI_KEY`. Nothing is generated until the variable `DEVOS_MEDIA_BUDGET` is above 0 (PR-81).
